from build123d import *
from bd_warehouse.fastener import CounterSunkScrew, ClearanceHole

PARAMS = {
    "length": 119.0,
    "width": 34.0,
    "thickness": 8.0,
    "hole_spacing": 45.0,
}

screw = CounterSunkScrew(size="M4-0.7", fastener_type="iso10642", length=10)

with BuildPart() as p:
    Box(PARAMS["length"], PARAMS["width"], PARAMS["thickness"],
        align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    with Locations(p.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]):
        with GridLocations(PARAMS["hole_spacing"], 0.0, 3, 1):
            ClearanceHole(fastener=screw, fit="Normal", counter_sunk=True)
result = p.part
